**Visual analysis of test image:**
- Soybean leaf with scattered circular spots
- Dark brown/black centers with distinct yellow-chlorotic halos
- Some spots show reddish-purple ring borders
- Multiple spots scattered across an otherwise green leaf
- Spots are roughly circular to slightly angular, varying in size

**Key matching features:**
- The circular spots with **dark centers + yellow halos + reddish-purple borders** are the hallmark of Frogeye leaf spot
- Matches description: "brown to grayish spots with brown-reddish borders" and "a yellow halo may be present around leaf spots"
- The "reddish-brown or purple ring surrounding round leaf spots" is the distinguishing diagnostic feature

The Frogeye reference collage shows later-stage lesions (shot holes, advanced yellowing), while the test image represents an earlier infection stage where the characteristic dark-centered spots with yellow halos are clearly visible before they fall out.

The scattered distribution on an otherwise green leaf and the spot morphology (dark center, yellow halo, purple-reddish border) match the frogeye description precisely."}
